Remark
[Remark 2.1] 1. ch13:2.1The cut locus, for surfaces, was introduced as the "ligne de partage" by H. Poincaré in 1905 [Po]. For Riemannian manifolds it was introduced by J. H. C. Whitehead in 1935 [Wh], who proved several of the properties presented here (pp. 700–704 of [Wh]). Interest revived in 1959 when Klingenberg [Kℓ 1] showed its usefulness in improving the "pinching" of the sphere theorem.
